meta.title: Commute Advisor
meta.description: Car or motorcycle today, based on the chance of rain during your commute

reason.departureHigh: {risk}% chance of rain on the way in, at {source} ({window})
reason.returnHigh: {risk}% chance of rain on the way home, at {source} ({window})
reason.bothLow: Both trips below the {threshold}% threshold · highest {max}%
reason.incomplete: No rain probability yet for the {trip} trip at {source} ({hours})

chart.title: Hourly chance of rain
chart.subtitle: Today · blue bands are your trips · dashed line is the {threshold}% threshold
chart.summary: Chance of rain, {series}: highest {dep} percent outbound, {ret} percent on the return, threshold {threshold} percent

dashboard.noForecast: No forecast fetched yet · tap to update
dashboard.returnWarning: Return rain risk is now {risk}% · bring rain gear

locations.title: Set your home and work
locations.body: The recommendation needs a forecast for both places.

days.title: No commute days selected
days.body: Choose at least one commute day in Settings.

placeholder.weather: Hourly forecast for home and work
placeholder.settings: Locations, commute times, rain threshold and notifications
placeholder.comingIn: This screen is built in Phase 5

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.preview: If the chance of rain is {value}% or more, the app recommends the car

errors.invalid: Check the values and try again

location.geoDenied: Location access was denied. Search for a place or enter coordinates.
location.name: Name

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a code. No password needed.
auth.closed: This is a private app and sign-up is closed. If this email has an account, the code arrives within a few minutes.

code.label: Code from the email
code.hint: Sent to {email}. The code is valid for 10 minutes.

error.invalidEmail: That email looks wrong. Check the spelling and try again.
error.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired. Try again, or ask for a new code.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.sendFailed: The email could not be sent. Try again in a moment.

chart.title: Chance of rain at {place}
chart.subtitle: {day} · blue bands are your trips · dashed line is the {threshold}% threshold

list.title: Hour by hour

weather.empty: No forecast for this day yet

history.bar: Car {car} days, motorcycle {motorcycle} days, no call {unknown} days
history.empty: No recommendations recorded in {month}. A day appears here once you open the app on a commute day.

locations.title: Set your home and work
locations.body: The forecast is fetched for both places, and each trip uses the higher chance of rain of the two.

commute.title: Commute times and days
commute.body: These are the defaults. Change them if your commute differs.

notifications.title: Morning notification
notifications.body: On each commute day at {time} you get one message with the vehicle and the main reason, built from a forecast fetched shortly before.
notifications.example: Car · return trip 70% chance of rain
notifications.iphone: On iPhone, notifications need the app added to the Home Screen first (iOS 16.4 or later).
notifications.unavailable: Notifications are not switched on yet. The recommendation works without them.
